name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the mining-friendly Salta province of Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study outlining a CAD$4.2B after-tax NPV and received final environmental approval in June 2026, positioning Diablillos as one of the premier undeveloped silver-gold projects globally with 124 Moz silver and 1.1 Moz gold in reserves.
